changelog.note: 197 (plan 197 K2): the ticket taught from its development half alone: the fields from `type-propose belepo_jegy` (the fact names that recur, the synonyms joined by hand), their meanings and written forms from the development half's labels (`type-propose --shapes`); the legacy pack's prompt and descriptions were not used. Measured on the evaluation half.

label: Belépőjegy (tanított jelölt)
document: An admission ticket to an event (a match or a concert) with the event, its time and place, the ticket holder and the holder's seat

fields.label: Jegyazonosító
fields.meaning: the ticket's own identifier, the number printed as its id (azonosító)

fields.label: Tulajdonos neve
fields.meaning: the name of the person the ticket is issued to (név)

fields.label: Esemény neve
fields.meaning: the event the ticket admits to, as printed: the match's two teams with the dash between them, or the concert's title (mérkőzés, meccs, párharc, párosítás)

fields.label: Esemény időpontja
fields.meaning: the event's date and starting time, written as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (időpont, dátum és idő)

fields.label: Rendezvény helyszíne
fields.meaning: the name of the stadium, arena or hall where the event is held, as printed (helyszín); not its address

fields.label: Születési hely
fields.meaning: the ticket holder's place of birth (születési hely)

fields.label: Születési dátum
fields.meaning: the ticket holder's date of birth (születési idő)

fields.label: Kártyaszám
fields.meaning: the number of the holder's club or fan card printed on the ticket (kártyaszám)

fields.label: Kapu
fields.meaning: the entrance gate exactly as printed in the ticket's gate field (Kapu/Gate), with every word and gate number of that field, not only its first part

fields.label: Szektor
fields.meaning: the sector as printed in the ticket's sector field (Szektor/Sector), with its mark and the word that follows the mark

fields.label: Sor
fields.meaning: the row number within the sector (Sor/Row)

fields.label: Szék
fields.meaning: the seat number within the row (Szék/Seat)
